root.label: Malta Air flight engine and window incident

events.label: Malta Air flight engine and window incident

slots.name: passenger count
slots.sentence: A loud bang was heard and the cabin’s altitude warning alarm blared, and oxygen masks dropped for 149 passengers.

slots.name: captain flight hours
slots.sentence: The captain, who was not identified, had tallied 8,270 flight hours.

slots.name: climb altitude
slots.sentence: The flight in Greece last month climbed to about 16,000 feet, less than 10 minutes after takeoff, when the aircraft’s engine began vibrating.

slots.name: injured passenger age
slots.sentence: One window shattered, and a 61-year-old man had his head sucked out the window , with his wife and other passengers pulling at his legs and body.

slots.name: event date
slots.sentence: The flight attendants prepared for cabin service on July 10 when they heard and felt a “loud continuous vibration,” investigators said.

slots.name: aircraft age
slots.sentence: aviation tracking sites said the aircraft had been flying since 2008.
